ucs.title: [LLM] Bluenoroff/TA444 'DangerousPassword' job-lure ISO/archive spawning PowerShell download cradle
ucs.description: Hunts the Bluenoroff (Sapphire Sleet / TA444 / APT38) crypto-recruiter intrusion chain where a job-themed ZIP/ISO/IMG dropped via LinkedIn or spearphish is opened, the mounted volume or extractor spawns a Windows script interpreter, and that interpreter pulls down a Rust/Go second stage from cloud storage. The chain (archive/ISO container → wscript/PowerShell child → outbound HTTPS staging) is signature Bluenoroff and is observed across SnatchCrypto, DangerousPassword and Hidden Risk operations targeting crypto/Web3 employees.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime FROM datamodel=Endpoint.Processes WHERE Processes.parent_process_name IN ("explorer.exe","7zg.exe","7zfm.exe","winrar.exe","rar.exe","unrar.exe","msiexec.exe") AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","curl.exe") AND (Processes.process="*DownloadString*" OR Processes.process="*Invoke-WebRequest*" OR Processes.process="*DownloadFile*" OR Processes.process="*-EncodedCommand*" OR Processes.process="*-enc *" OR Processes.process="*FromBase64String*" OR Processes.process="*Net.WebClient*" OR Processes.process="*BitsTransfer*" OR Processes.parent_process="*.iso*" OR Processes.parent_process="*.img*" OR Processes.parent_process="*\\Volume{*" OR Processes.parent_process="*job*" OR Processes.parent_process="*offer*" OR Processes.parent_process="*recruit*" OR Processes.parent_process="*interview*" OR Processes.parent_process="*salary*" OR Processes.parent_process="*crypto*" OR Processes.parent_process="*coinbase*" OR Processes.parent_process="*binance*" OR Processes.parent_process="*kraken*" OR Processes.parent_process="*ledger*" OR Processes.parent_process="*portfolio*") BY Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where NOT match(user, "\$$") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort 0 - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LureTokens = dynamic(["job","offer","recruit","interview","salary","package","compensation","jd","resume","cv","portfolio","crypto","coinbase","binance","kraken","gemini","ledger","metamask","trustwallet","blockchain","defi","nft","staking","web3"]);
let SuspChildren = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","curl.exe","cmd.exe"]);
let DownloadTokens = dynamic(["DownloadString","DownloadFile","Invoke-WebRequest","iwr ","BitsTransfer","Net.WebClient","FromBase64String","Invoke-Expression","IEX(","-EncodedCommand","-enc ","-ec "]);
let ArchiveParents = dynamic(["explorer.exe","7zg.exe","7zfm.exe","winrar.exe","rar.exe","unrar.exe","msiexec.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where (InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (ArchiveParents))
     or InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any ("\\Device\\CdRom","\\Volume{",".iso",".img",".vhd")
| where FileName in~ (SuspChildren)
| extend ChildCmd = tolower(ProcessCommandLine), ParentCtx = tolower(strcat(InitiatingProcessFolderPath," ",InitiatingProcessCommandLine))
| where ChildCmd has_any (DownloadTokens)
     or ParentCtx has_any (LureTokens)
     or ParentCtx has_any (".iso",".img","\\volume{")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessFolderPath !startswith "C:\\Program Files"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256, InitiatingProcessSHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LureTokens = dynamic(["job","offer","recruit","interview","salary","package","jd","resume","portfolio","crypto","coinbase","binance","kraken","metamask","blockchain","defi","web3"]);
let SuspChildren = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","curl.exe"]);
let DownloadTokens = dynamic(["DownloadString","DownloadFile","Invoke-WebRequest","BitsTransfer","Net.WebClient","FromBase64String","IEX(","-EncodedCommand","-enc "]);
let ArchiveParents = dynamic(["explorer.exe","7zg.exe","7zfm.exe","winrar.exe","rar.exe","unrar.exe","msiexec.exe"]);
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where (ParentProcessName has_any (ArchiveParents))
     or ParentProcessCommandLine has_any (".iso",".img","\\Volume{","\\Device\\CdRom")
| where ActingProcessName has_any (SuspChildren)
| extend ChildCmd = tolower(ActingProcessCommandLine), ParentCtx = tolower(ParentProcessCommandLine)
| where ChildCmd has_any (DownloadTokens)
     or ParentCtx has_any (LureTokens)
     or ParentCtx has_any (".iso",".img","\\volume{")
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ParentProcessName, ParentProcessCommandLine, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Bluenoroff Job-Lure Archive/ISO Spawning Script Interpreter With Download Cradle
id: 7d2e8a1b-c4f6-4321-9e08-bluenrffuc01
status: experimental
description: Detects an archive extractor or mounted ISO/IMG container spawning a script interpreter that runs a remote download/IEX cradle. Matches the Bluenoroff (TA444 / Sapphire Sleet / APT38) DangerousPassword and SnatchCrypto job-recruiter delivery chain.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0098/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1566.001
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.g0098
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent_archive:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\explorer.exe'
      - '\7zg.exe'
      - '\7zfm.exe'
      - '\winrar.exe'
      - '\rar.exe'
      - '\msiexec.exe'
  parent_iso:
    ParentImage|contains:
      - '\Device\CdRom'
      - '\Volume{'
      - '.iso'
      - '.img'
  child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
  download_cradle:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'DownloadFile'
      - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
      - 'Net.WebClient'
      - 'BitsTransfer'
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - '-EncodedCommand'
      - '-enc '
      - 'IEX('
  condition: (parent_archive or parent_iso) and child and download_cradle
falsepositives:
  - Vendor installers that bundle PowerShell post-install scripts
  - Admin packaging tools mounting ISOs in build pipelines
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\explorer.exe OR *\\Explorer.exe OR *\\EXPLORER.EXE OR *\\7zg.exe OR *\\7zG.exe OR *\\7zfm.exe OR *\\7zFM.exe OR *\\winrar.exe OR *\\WinRAR.exe OR *\\rar.exe OR *\\msiexec.exe OR *\\MsiExec.exe) @Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\WScript.exe OR *\\WSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\CScript.exe OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\RunDll32.exe OR *\\curl.exe) @CommandLine:(*DownloadString* OR *DownloadFile* OR *Invoke-WebRequest* OR *Net.WebClient* OR *BitsTransfer* OR *FromBase64String* OR *-EncodedCommand* OR *-enc\ * OR *IEX* OR *iex\ *)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(explorer|7zg|7zfm|winrar|rar|unrar|msiexec)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/(powershell|pwsh|wscript|cscript|mshta|rundll32|curl)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(downloadstring|downloadfile|invoke-webrequest|net\\.webclient|bitstransfer|frombase64string|-encodedcommand|-enc\\b|\\biex\\(|invoke-expression)", field=CommandLine)
| UserName!=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, SHA256HashData], function=count(), limit=200)
ucs.rationale: Bluenoroff/TA444 is the ONLY major DPRK cluster that pairs (a) crypto/finance employee social-engineering lures with (b) ISO/IMG/ZIP container delivery to bypass Mark-of-the-Web, and then (c) a script-interpreter download cradle for Rust/Go second stages (RustBucket Windows port, ObjCShellz Windows variants, ROKRAT-style loaders). Generic APT detections fire on PowerShell+download alone; this quer

ucs.title: [LLM] Bluenoroff/SnatchCrypto non-browser process accessing crypto wallet extension data / browser secrets
ucs.description: Hunts the Bluenoroff (TA444 / APT38) wallet-drain end-stage where the malware reads or stages Chromium 'Local Extension Settings' directories for MetaMask, Phantom, TronLink, Coinbase Wallet, Trust Wallet and Binance Chain, or Chrome 'Login Data' / 'Local State' — a behavior central to SnatchCrypto, CryptoCore and the AppleJeus-Windows wallet stealers. Fires when the actor process is not a known browser, which is the differentiator from benign extension activity.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime FROM datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem WHERE (Filesystem.file_path="*\\Local Extension Settings\\nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Local Extension Settings\\bfnaelmomeimhlpmgjnjophhpkkoljpa*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Local Extension Settings\\ibnejdfjmmkpcnlpebklmnkoeoihofec*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Local Extension Settings\\hnfanknocfeofbddgcijnmhnfnkdnaad*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Local Extension Settings\\egjidjbpglichdcondbcbdnbeeppgdph*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Local Extension Settings\\fhbohimaelbohpjbbldcngcnapndodjp*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Login Data*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Local State*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*wallet.dat*") AND NOT Filesystem.process_name IN ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","brave.exe","firefox.exe","opera.exe","vivaldi.exe","yandex.exe","msedgewebview2.exe","explorer.exe") BY Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.process_path Filesystem.process_guid Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.action | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | where NOT match(user, "\$$") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort 0 - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let WalletExtIds = dynamic([
  "nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn",  // MetaMask
  "bfnaelmomeimhlpmgjnjophhpkkoljpa",  // Phantom
  "ibnejdfjmmkpcnlpebklmnkoeoihofec",  // TronLink
  "hnfanknocfeofbddgcijnmhnfnkdnaad",  // Coinbase Wallet
  "egjidjbpglichdcondbcbdnbeeppgdph",  // Trust Wallet
  "fhbohimaelbohpjbbldcngcnapndodjp",  // Binance Chain
  "ejbalbakoplchlghecdalmeeeajnimhm",  // MetaMask (Edge)
  "afbcbjpbpfadlkmhmclhkeeodmamcflc"   // MathWallet
]);
let LegitBrowsers = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","brave.exe","firefox.exe","opera.exe","vivaldi.exe","yandex.exe","msedgewebview2.exe","iexplore.exe"]);
let PathTokens = dynamic(["\\Local Extension Settings\\","\\Login Data","\\Local State","wallet.dat","keystore","\\Cookies"]);
union isfuzzy=true
  (DeviceFileEvents
   | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
   | where FolderPath has_any (WalletExtIds)
        or (FolderPath has_any (PathTokens) and FolderPath !has "Microsoft\\Edge\\User Data\\Default\\Sync Data")
   | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (LegitBrowsers)
   | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
   | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName=InitiatingProcessAccountName, Source="FileEvent",
             ActorImage=InitiatingProcessFolderPath, ActorFile=InitiatingProcessFileName,
             ActorCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine, ActorSHA=InitiatingProcessSHA256,
             ActionType, TargetPath=FolderPath, TargetFile=FileName),
  (DeviceProcessEvents
   | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
   | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (WalletExtIds)
        or ProcessCommandLine has_any (PathTokens)
   | where FileName !in~ (LegitBrowsers)
   | where AccountName !endswith "$"
   | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, Source="ProcessCmd",
             ActorImage=FolderPath, ActorFile=FileName,
             ActorCmd=ProcessCommandLine, ActorSHA=SHA256,
             ActionType="ProcessCreated", TargetPath="", TargetFile="")
| summarize FirstSeen=min(Timestamp), LastSeen=max(Timestamp), HitCount=count(),
            SampleCmd=any(ActorCmd), Targets=make_set(TargetPath, 25)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, ActorImage, ActorFile, ActorSHA
| order by LastSeen desc
